properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.enabled
properties.description: Load versioned specialist manifests, schemas, and prompt profiles during application startup.

properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.fail-fast
properties.description: Fail application startup when a specialist resource cannot be loaded, validated, compiled, or merged.

properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.locations
properties.description: Classpath or mounted resource patterns containing immutable specialist YAML or JSON documents.

properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.max-manifest-bytes
properties.description: Maximum canonical byte size of one Specialist manifest document.

properties.name: ai.execution.manifests.max-resource-bytes
properties.description: Maximum byte size of one configured specialist resource file.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.enabled
properties.description: Enable durable, separately authorized human review around governed action proposal receipts.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.repository
properties.description: Review task and dispatch receipt repository. JDBC is required for durable cross-process review.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.initialize-schema
properties.description: Create review JDBC tables at startup. Intended for tests and self-contained demos; production applications should own migrations.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.decision-lease-duration
properties.description: Lease duration for one claimed review decision continuation.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.recovery-interval
properties.description: Interval between expired-task, abandoned-decision, and retention recovery scans.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.recovery-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum review tasks processed by one recovery scan.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.max-dispatch-attempts
properties.description: Maximum idempotent dispatcher delivery attempts retained for one waiting review task.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.max-decision-attempts
properties.description: Maximum durable continuation claims before a review decision fails visibly.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.cleanup-enabled
properties.description: Delete terminal review tasks after the configured retention period.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.retention
properties.description: Retention period for terminal review tasks when cleanup is enabled.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.encryption-secret
properties.description: Stable secret used to encrypt protected review source, decision, and result state. Must be at least 32 characters and distinct from receipt secrets.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.fingerprint-secret
properties.description: Stable secret used for keyed reviewer, tenant, source, and idempotency fingerprints. Must be at least 32 characters and distinct from receipt secrets.

properties.name: ai.execution.reviews.allow-in-production
properties.description: Explicitly acknowledge non-durable IN_MEMORY review state under a prod or production profile.
